title: Exact Brand Name on Label
tests: Produces a finished product image with exact, legible brand lettering integrated into the bottle label.

judge.summary: A clean product photo shows an amber glass bottle with a cream label and clearly readable, correctly spelled VELORA branding.

must_haves.item: An amber glass hand soap bottle is the main subject.
must_haves.why: A single amber glass bottle is prominently centered as the product subject; its screw cap does not conflict with the requested bottle.

must_haves.item: A cream-colored label is visibly attached to the bottle.
must_haves.why: A large cream-colored label visibly wraps around the bottle.

must_haves.item: The label reads exactly 'VELORA' in clear uppercase letters.
must_haves.why: The label clearly reads VELORA in uppercase, with all six letters correctly spelled.

must_haves.item: The brand lettering sits within the label and looks integrated, not like a floating caption.
must_haves.why: The black lettering is centered within the cream label and appears printed on it.

must_haves.item: The brand name is unobscured and readable at the delivered image size.
must_haves.why: The large, high-contrast brand name is fully visible and easy to read.
